claim: list_overdue uses `due_date <= today` — tasks due today are incorrectly flagged overdue (off-by-one).
test_output:
AssertionError: Expected [] but got [Task(title='Due today'...)] — task due today was incorrectly marked overdue
assert [Task(...)] == []
1 failed in 0.18s
fix_diff:
--- a/taskboard/service.py
+++ b/taskboard/service.py
@@ -57,7 +57,7 @@
             for task in self._repo.list_all()
-            if task.due_date is not None and task.due_date <= today
+            if not task.done and task.due_date is not None and task.due_date < today
